related.title: Sigstore Bundle：離線證據與簽署時間有效期
related.titleEn: Sigstore bundles: offline evidence and signing-time validity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：58.333%與75%由逐關卡交集重算；未知buildType及錯主體保持拒絕，未宣稱自動取得SLSA認證。 交付slsa-contract.json、逐關卡矩陣與未知buildType反例，附來源版本與本地政策版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute approximately 58.333 and 75 percent from gate intersections, reject unknown build types and wrong subjects, and make no automatic SLSA certification claim. Deliver slsa-contract.json, the gate matrix and an unknown-buildType counterexample with both specification and local policy revisions recorded.
related.difference: 建立產物摘要、憑證鏈、簽章、可信時間證據及信任根版本表；區分Rekor v1時間證據與v2的獨立TSA路徑，依選定驗證器版本固定格式。
related.differenceEn: Record artifact digest, certificate chain, signature, trusted time evidence and trust-root revision. Distinguish the Rekor v1 timestamp path from v2 use of an independent TSA, pinning the chosen verifier and bundle format rather than mixing incompatible assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: v1.2規格的build provenance使用v1 predicate類型；buildType決定參數語意，未知類型不能用猜測欄位規則通過。課堂准入是本地政策，不自動授予SLSA等級。 12筆中10筆主體與builder符合，當中7筆參數及解析相依皆符合；其餘列分別標明未核准目標或相依摘要。 完整契約通過率7/12×100≈58.333%；補正兩筆已通過其他關卡的相依解析證據後為9/12×100=75%。
本課先假設鏈、時間簽章與身分政策通過，再計算簽署時間距有效期兩端的較小餘裕；此數值不是撤銷或來源政策的替代。 憑證有效區間1000至1600秒，可信簽署時間1300秒；觀測時刻可以晚於憑證到期，但必須保有符合選定驗證流程的歷史時間證據。 兩端餘裕min(1300−1000,1600−1300)=300秒；可信時間改1550後較小餘裕50秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The v1.2 build-provenance specification uses the v1 predicate type. buildType defines parameter semantics, so an unknown type cannot pass through guessed field interpretation. This consumer policy does not itself certify a SLSA level. Ten of 12 records match subject and builder, and seven of those also satisfy parameter and resolved-dependency expectations. Mark each remaining row with an unapproved target or dependency digest rather than a generic failed status. Full-contract admission is 7/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent. Correcting resolved-dependency evidence in two otherwise acceptable rows raises it to 9/12×100=75 percent, without broadening the trusted builder set.

After independent chain, timestamp-signature and identity-policy checks pass, calculate the smaller distance from signing time to the certificate validity endpoints. This number does not replace revocation considerations, provenance policy or verification of the timestamp authority. The certificate interval is 1000 through 1600 seconds and trusted signing time is 1300. Observation may occur later, but acceptance requires historical time evidence appropriate to the selected verification workflow, not merely a certificate that once existed. Endpoint margin is min(1300−1000, 1600−1300)=300 seconds. Moving trusted signing time to 1550 reduces it to 50 seconds, while leaving artifact and identity checks independently necessary.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Bazel：動作快取鍵、隱藏輸入與可信寫入者
related.titleEn: Bazel: action-cache keys, hidden inputs and trusted writers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：58.333%與75%由逐關卡交集重算；未知buildType及錯主體保持拒絕，未宣稱自動取得SLSA認證。 交付slsa-contract.json、逐關卡矩陣與未知buildType反例，附來源版本與本地政策版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute approximately 58.333 and 75 percent from gate intersections, reject unknown build types and wrong subjects, and make no automatic SLSA certification claim. Deliver slsa-contract.json, the gate matrix and an unknown-buildType counterexample with both specification and local policy revisions recorded.
related.difference: 建立20個建置動作描述，列宣告輸入、工具鏈、命令、環境及輸出摘要；另標記實際讀到但未納入契約的檔案或變數。
related.differenceEn: Build 20 action descriptors with declared inputs, toolchain, command, environment and output digests. Separately mark files or variables actually consumed but absent from the action contract, making hidden dependencies visible before analyzing cache reuse.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: v1.2規格的build provenance使用v1 predicate類型；buildType決定參數語意，未知類型不能用猜測欄位規則通過。課堂准入是本地政策，不自動授予SLSA等級。 12筆中10筆主體與builder符合，當中7筆參數及解析相依皆符合；其餘列分別標明未核准目標或相依摘要。 完整契約通過率7/12×100≈58.333%；補正兩筆已通過其他關卡的相依解析證據後為9/12×100=75%。
本課封閉性覆蓋率為已完整列出影響輸入的動作比例；只有覆蓋完整仍不足以證明寫入者可信，快取ACL與產物完整性另列關卡。 20個動作中15個輸入契約完整，5個缺少時區、工具版本或工作目錄依賴；每個缺口列出可重現的反例變數。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；修正其中3個動作後為18/20×100=90%，剩下2個仍不能宣稱封閉。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The v1.2 build-provenance specification uses the v1 predicate type. buildType defines parameter semantics, so an unknown type cannot pass through guessed field interpretation. This consumer policy does not itself certify a SLSA level. Ten of 12 records match subject and builder, and seven of those also satisfy parameter and resolved-dependency expectations. Mark each remaining row with an unapproved target or dependency digest rather than a generic failed status. Full-contract admission is 7/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent. Correcting resolved-dependency evidence in two otherwise acceptable rows raises it to 9/12×100=75 percent, without broadening the trusted builder set.

Define closure coverage as the fraction of actions whose influential inputs are fully declared. Complete closure alone does not authenticate a cache writer; write authorization and artifact integrity remain separate gates in the cache trust model. Fifteen of 20 actions have complete input contracts. Five omit timezone, tool version or working-directory dependencies, with a reproducible counterexample variable recorded for each omission rather than an unexplained nonhermetic label. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Repairing three actions gives 18/20×100=90 percent; the remaining two still prevent a claim of complete declared-input closure.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
